templates.name: VMware Replication
templates.description:
VMware Replication monitoring via REST API. Discovers pairings, replicated VMs and replication servers, collects replication status, configuration state, sync metrics, vCenter/VRM status and API collection errors.


Author: Yaroslav Sharaev https://github.com/NicKerrr/zabbix-templates
